problem_statement: The RTIO executor does not handle an AWAIT operation when no rtio_iodev is attached to the submission. Such a 'relaxed' await should pause only that one submission chain until it is explicitly signaled via rtio_sqe_signal(), while the iodev stays free to serve unrelated submissions from other chains. Without this, a relaxed await submission either fails the chain immediately (the executor only knew CALLBACK and DELAY) or has no way to be paused-and-resumed, so it cannot be used as a logical sequencing step that does not lock a bus.
twister_command: scripts/twister -p native_sim/native/64 -T tests/subsys/rtio/rtio_api -s tests/subsys/rtio/rtio_api/rtio.api -s rtio.api -O twister-out --no-clean -W
